'''ShadowShard Dark Dealing With Dark Jedi (VSC)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ShadowShard]]
* '''Published:''' 21 April 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Deal ShadowShard DS 2002 DarkDeal.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Make your opponent think twice before coming in and messing with you on Cloud City.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Alright. The main point (like any other dark deal deck) is to get massive drains and power. If anyone decides they want to drop by and stop you, you can wipe them out with your Dark Jedis. Almost every character has a weapon they can use.

On the first turn I would pull your two sites before activating. Then activate and pull Bespin or Cloud City. While looking through your reserve check and see if the Executor is in there. If it is pull it with Mob Points. If you opponent plays Don't Do that Again, just do your best to get a starship to Bespin, then pull it. If you get the Imperial Command, go ahead and pull Thrawn. The next couple turns should involve setting up Dark Deal and Occupation. After that just drain and beat down your opponent if he comes to mess with you. Your drains should be enough to make him weep.

CARD CHOICES:

Guri - Only one Destiny for opponent and can be retrieved using Droid Incinerator.

Destroyer Droids - These guys can really hurt your opponent by hitting them and making them lose force. Can be retrieved using Droid Incinerator

Return to Base - All you lost starships go here; works well with TMNALTC

TMNALTC - Great Card. Executor Deploys free to Bespin. TIEs can be taken into hand after they are lost.

All too Easy - Since you have so many lightsabers, why not play this card? Your opponent loses 8 force along with their character.

Blow Parried - Protect yourself when in Lightsaber Combat

Talon Roll Combo - Easy way to get rid of starships that come to the Cloud City Sector.

Force Field - Protect your Dark Jedi from getting gunned down

Battle Deployment - If you can get this card out, it would cancel I'll take the Leader (If out), it would subtract the power of your opponents starships by 2 (Unless they have a capital starship, but they usually wont) and it would prevent them from drawing more than one Battle Destiny.

Cloud City: Droid Incenerator - Retrieve the many droids which are in this Deck

Let me know what you think

-ShadowShard
